reader.requirement: When a MOVE statement or an input-output statement (WRITE/REWRITE FROM, READ/RETURN INTO, RELEASE FROM, or the record itself) references a group item containing an index data item, the index item's storage is transferred as part of the group image with no conversion, so its occurrence value survives the transfer.

edition-consulted.switches: passes the compiling --std to CobolFile.Register, which selects the edition's I/O status behaviours; the record image transferred is the same group image at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel in MoveClassifier.cs, MoveTable16.cs, MoveEmitter.cs, GroupImageCodec.cs, PlaceRenderer.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs, SortEmitter.cs: only MoveEmitter#AllLiteralNumber (ALL literal into numeric, not on this path) and the file register's edition argument; the index item's 8-byte binary image (PicInfo#ByteForm Usage.Index => Binary) is edition-free.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses are MOVE/READ INTO/RELEASE/RETURN cases written for other rules; none puts an index data item inside the transferred group

reader.notes: An index data item is a record-struct field whose group image is its fixed 8-byte big-endian binary form (implementor-defined representation, GR7); AsImage/FromImage copy it unchanged, so every group transfer is conversion-free. Probed MOVE, sequential WRITE/READ INTO, relative WRITE/REWRITE/READ INTO, SORT RELEASE/RETURN, and an ODO group; identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: §1985:III.2 (cite.py: OK  §1985:III.2 the text is in the clause) makes DISPLAY and ACCEPT input-output statements in 1985, an operand class the reader did not probe. refute-1985-192/src/idxdsp.cob at --std 85: DISPLAY of group G1 (X(3), USAGE INDEX = 7, X(2)) emits the bytes 'ABC' 00x7 07 'DE' (od -c), byte-identical to MOVE G1 TO ALNUM then DISPLAY ALNUM: the index item's image is transferred unconverted on DISPLAY as on MOVE.
